description: cases: the raw CIDv1 (0x01 0x55 0x12 0x20 ‖ SHA-256) of bytes, in binary and base32 text. decode: binary CIDs and their parts. invalid: binary CIDs that must be rejected: varints are minimal, and a sha2-256 or keccak-256 digest is 32 bytes. registry: CID bytes against the registry's rule CID-1, which accepts no CID (empty) or 34 to 64 bytes starting with 0x01 and checks nothing else.

unixfs.description: The CID of a file added to IPFS with CIDv1, raw leaves, a fixed 1 MiB chunker and the balanced layout. Byte k of the file is k mod 251. Up to 1 MiB the file is one raw block; above it, a dag-pb root whose links name the raw leaves in order, each with an empty name and the leaf's size, and whose UnixFS data is a File with the total size and each leaf's size.

cases.name: 1 MiB + 1 byte: a dag-pb root over two raw leaves
2 MiB + 5 bytes: three leaves, the last of 5 bytes
